chapter: Compositions, singers and the end of the big band
title: Buck Clayton
summary: He recalls Clayton and Edison with Count and saw Clayton in France.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: What about one other trumpet player I was thinking about? Buck Clayton?
That's who I was trying to think of. A few minutes ago when you asked me about Count? Yeah. That's the name. That's the trumpet player - Buck Clayton.
Yeah. Shoot. That's who I was trying to think of. The last time I saw him was in France. Yeah. We was over there together. Buck was a sweetheart.
He, Buck Clayton, and Harry Edison. Those are the two I was thinking of together with Count when he first came to New York.
Yeah. Now, I'm glad cause I've been worrying myself about that name. I knew it.
